title: A unit orientation of Q equals ± evaluation at any orthonormal frame in Q (orthonormal change of frame has determinant ±1)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, let Q ⊆ ℝ^P be a linear subspace, let ζ be an m-vector (ζ ∈ MultiVector P m, a continuous linear functional on m-covectors) which is a unit orientation of Q (IsUnitOrientationOf ζ Q: there is an orthonormal τ : Fin m → ℝ^P with span(range τ) = Q and either ζ(β) = β(τ) for every m-covector β or ζ(β) = −β(τ) for every m-covector β), and let ρ : Fin m → ℝ^P be an orthonormal family with ρ_j ∈ Q for every j. Then either ζ(β) = β(ρ) for every m-covector β, or ζ(β) = −β(ρ) for every m-covector β.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (ζ : MultiVector P m) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (ρ : Fin m → Euclid P), IsUnitOrientationOf ζ Q → Orthonormal ℝ ρ → (∀ j, ρ j ∈ Q) → (∀ β : Covector (Euclid P) m, ζ β = β ρ) ∨ ∀ β : Covector (Euclid P) m, ζ β = -β ρ
